blocks.prompt: 8. If \((p + q)\)th term of a G.P. be \(m\) and \((p - q)\)th term be \(n\), then find the \(p\)th term.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein numbers nahi, letters hain, lekin tareeqa wohi formula wala hai.
Diya kya hai? \((p + q)\)th term \(= m\) aur \((p - q)\)th term \(= n\).
Find kya karna hai? \(p\)th term.
Ghaur kijiye: \(p\)th term bilkul beech mein hai, ek se \(q\) qadam aage aur doosre se \(q\) qadam peeche. Is liye dono equations multiply karne se \(q\) cancel ho jayega.
Plan: dono terms likhna, multiply karna, aur \(a_1 r^{p-1}\) ko pehchanna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_{p+q} = m\), \(a_{p-q} = n\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a_p\).
Tareeqa: Dono terms ko \(a_k = a_1 r^{k-1}\) se likhenge aur equations ko multiply karenge. Multiply is liye, kyunke powers jama hoti hain aur \(+q\), \(-q\) aapas mein khatam ho jate hain.

Dono terms ki equations
\[a_1 r^{p+q-1} = m \quad (1)\]
\[a_1 r^{p-q-1} = n \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(k\) ki jagah \(p + q\) rakha to power \(p + q - 1\) aayi, aur \(p - q\) rakha to \(p - q - 1\). Letters se ghabrane ki zaroorat nahi; yeh bilkul \(a_4 = a_1 r^3\) jaisa hi kaam hai.

(1) aur (2) multiply karein
\[a_1^2\, r^{(p+q-1) + (p-q-1)} = mn\]
\[a_1^2\, r^{2p-2} = mn\]
\[\left(a_1 r^{p-1}\right)^2 = mn\]
Kyun: Left sides ko aapas mein aur right sides ko aapas mein multiply kiya. \(a_1 \cdot a_1 = a_1^2\), aur \(r\) ki powers jama hui: \(p + q - 1 + p - q - 1 = 2p - 2\). \(2p - 2 = 2(p - 1)\) hai, is liye poori left side \(a_1 r^{p-1}\) ka square ban gayi.
Dhyan dein: Powers jama karte waqt \(-1\) do dafa aata hai; \(2p - 1\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

\(p\)th term pehchanein
\[a_p = a_1 r^{p-1}\]
\[a_p^2 = mn \Rightarrow a_p = \sqrt{mn}\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar bilkul \(a_p\) ka formula hai, is liye \(a_p^2 = mn\). Square root lene par asal mein \(\pm\sqrt{mn}\) aata hai; kitab positive root leti hai, jo tab sahi hai jab terms positive hon (aam taur par yahi hota hai). Exam mein kitab wala jawab \(\sqrt{mn}\) likhiye.
Yaad rakhiye: is ka matlab hai ke \(a_p\) dono terms ka geometric mean hai, kyunke woh un ke bilkul beech mein hai.

Tasdeeq: numbers se
\[3, 6, 12, 24, 48, 96, \ldots;\ p = 5, q = 2\]
\[m = a_7 = 192,\ n = a_3 = 12\]
\[\sqrt{mn} = \sqrt{2304} = 48 = a_5\ \checkmark\]
Kyun: Ek asli G.P. le kar \(p = 5\), \(q = 2\) rakha. 7th term 192 aur 3rd term 12 hai; \(\sqrt{192 \times 12} = 48\), jo waqai 5th term hai. Formula sahi kaam karta hai.
